name: framelark
description: Photography guidance, original photo retouching and curated series in three skills.

interface.longDescription: FrameLark bundles three photography skills: photography-eye finds viewpoints, timing and finishing targets; photo-retouch refines original photographs with local tools; photo-series defines a theme, selects and sequences images, and coordinates individual retouching. Your current agent provides visual reasoning. Image generation is optional and uses available host tools. Local photo processing requires Node.js 20.9+ and the bundled dependency setup.
defaultPrompt: 用 FrameLark 看看这个场景怎么拍，给我不同的拍法。
用 FrameLark 精修这张照片，先审片再给能比较的试片。
帮我按主题选一组照片，逐张精修后排成九宫格。
